rules: Retain Space Mono for all UI components, dashboard metrics, terminal logs, and system feedback. Ensure wide tracking (`tracking-wider`) for uppercase labels.
Retain Cormorant Garamond for generated narrative content, book reader interfaces, and elegant large display headings.
Never center-align UI text. Maintain a brutalist, asymmetrical left-alignment indicative of terminal legacy.
Replace all legacy #39FF14 (Green) with Neon Yellow (#E6FF00).
Replace all legacy #8A0303 (Blood Red) with Neon Hot Pink (#FF007F).
Use gradients purposefully on borders, active button states, and hover effects—keep gradient coverage under 20% of the screen.

visual_enhancers.ray_gun_punk_noir: Stark contrast between absolute black voids and blinding neon structures. UI elements must feel machined from dark, reflective chrome and powered by volatile energy.
visual_enhancers.borders: 0px border radius globally. Use sharp, jagged corners where possible. Structural borders should be `1px solid rgba(230, 255, 0, 0.2)`, illuminating fully on hover.
visual_enhancers.glows: Utilize layered box-shadows for the 'ray gun' energy bloom: `box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(230,255,0,0.5), 0 0 20px rgba(255,0,127,0.3)`. Use stark inner-shadows (`inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.3)`) to emulate sleek chrome edges.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep the existing CRT scanline and noise grain overlays, but ensure their mix-blend modes (e.g., `overlay` or `soft-light`) interact correctly with the new yellow/pink hues to create a dense, cinematic fog effect.

motion.page_transitions: CRT power-on/off flicker. Wrap routes in `<AnimatePresence>`. On Exit (Power Off): collapse scaleY to 0.01, spike brightness to 3, with a heavy #FF007F glow (duration: 0.35s). On Enter (Power On): expand scaleY from 0.01 to 1, utilizing a slow, soft ambient flicker (`opacity: [0, 1, 0.4, 1]`) in #E6FF00 (duration: 0.6s).
motion.hero_ambient: Particle/fog drift. Render large, highly blurred `div`s (`blur-[120px]`) in #E6FF00 and #FF007F behind a fixed noise layer. Use Framer Motion to slowly translate them across the viewport to simulate thick, glowing noir fog.
motion.hero_glitch: Glitch-in text reveal on mount. Utilize CSS `clip-path` polygon shifting accompanied by intense chromatic aberration text-shadows (`-3px 0 #E6FF00, 3px 0 #FF007F`). Snap to perfect alignment after 0.5s.
motion.book_hover: Extreme 3D tilt/parallax for dashboard covers. Implement using `react-parallax-tilt`. Settings must be exaggerated: `tiltMaxAngleX={35}`, `tiltMaxAngleY={35}`, `scale={1.1}`, `transitionSpeed={400}`, `glareEnable={true}`, `glareMaxOpacity={0.7}`, `glareColor='#E6FF00'`. The book must feel completely detached from the background.
motion.custom_cursor: Slick prism neon light tracker. A fixed Framer Motion element tracking `clientX/Y`. Composed of a sharp #E6FF00 center dot, surrounded by a trailing reactive geometric frame. The frame uses `box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px #E6FF00, 0 0 15px #FF007F` for a reflective chrome/prism look. Upon hovering interactive elements, the frame snaps to the target's bounding box and pulses.

layouts.spacing: Hyper-generous. Use `p-8` to `p-12` within bento grid containers. Negative space is essential to amplify the stark noir shadows.
layouts.grids: Asymmetric Bento Grids (`grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12`). Mix `col-span-8`, `col-span-4`, and empty structural columns (`col-span-2`) to create tension.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the high-intensity neon colors meet contrast standards against the #050505 background. Add `text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8)` if text intersects with the fog or bright glows.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Downgrade CRT flicker to a simple crossfade and disable the extreme 3D tilt for users who opt out.

component_instructions.buttons: Brutalist, 0px border radius. Default: transparent background, `border-b-2 border-r-2 border-[#E6FF00]`. Hover: Fill with `neon_fusion` gradient, inverse text color to black, intense shadow.
component_instructions.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism `bg-[#050505]/70 backdrop-blur-xl`. Bottom border `1px solid #FF007F`. Ensure the rotating logo and 'Neural Credit' balance badge use the new primary colors and emit a soft glow.
component_instructions.cards: For the reader/editor and settings panels, use stark `#111111` backgrounds with sharp 1px `#E6FF00` borders. No internal rounded corners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT rewrite existing business logic, Stripe integrations, block-generation states, or database queries. This is strictly a visual overlay and motion injection.
Update global CSS/Tailwind configs to replace the old spooky green/red with the new #E6FF00 (Neon Yellow) and #FF007F (Hot Pink).
Install and integrate `react-parallax-tilt` for the dashboard book grids.
Implement the global custom cursor using Framer Motion logic. It should be visually hidden on mobile viewports.
Build the CRT page transition wrapper utilizing Framer Motion's `<AnimatePresence>` around the main routes.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all new or structurally modified interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs (e.g., standard rounded SaaS cards). Embrace the sharp, experimental brutalism requested.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers—always use a dark scrim or blur to maintain text legibility.
Use `sonner` for all application toasts, styled to match the ray-gun punk aesthetic.
Every interaction (buttons, inputs, links) must have a reactive micro-animation (e.g., scale, color shift, or glitch).
